summary: End-to-end testing of Zero Sprechi Chef. Backend (6/6 pytest) and frontend flows (form, generation via Gemini, favorites CRUD, cookie banner, legal modals) all pass. Vegan exclusion rule works correctly (prosciutto/formaggio excluded and reasoned).

issues: Radix DialogContent is missing an aria-describedby / DialogDescription (console warning). A11y-only, not functional.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to Favorites detail Dialog and LegalModal DialogContent to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores recipe in Mongo via {**doc} spread (good – prevents _id leak into response). Confirmed no _id in API response.
parse_recipe_json is resilient to code fences; no fallback if JSON is malformed beyond fences – acceptable given Gemini output has been consistent.
generate_recipe returns 502 on any parsing/LLM failure – reasonable, propagated to Italian toast in Home.jsx.
seed_data_creation: None (LocalStorage-only favorites; two live Gemini calls made during tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root, empty-ingredient 400, recipe shape, disclaimer keywords ('etichette'/'prodotti'), no _id leak, vegan exclusion. Gemini calls take ~10-25s; use timeout>=120s. Frontend Playwright flow used data-testid selectors listed in review request. All passed on first run.
